newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish court to rule on key Telekom sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Turkish court to rule on key Telekom sell-off.

text.p: Turkey's constitutional court on Tuesday began a hearing to decide whether to approve the sale of Turk Telekom, the centrepiece of the government's privatisation plans.
The Islamist-led government hopes to raise $3.5 billion from the telecommunications giant, the sale of which has already been halted three times by the court since 1993.
The court's ruling on a fresh request by mainly leftist opposition MPs to block the sell-off again is expected within several days.
The first tranche of up to 15 percent of Telekom is to be sold by the end of the year if the court gives the green light, privatisation officials say.

Recent sales of a bank, tyre and cement factories and the leasings of port facilities have boosted Turkey's hopes of reaching a target of $5 billion from sell-offs this year. That figure does not include any revenues from Telekom.
